Create a new KiCad project named b23 in the project directory and draw its schematic for the following request.

Build a PMW3360DM-T2QU optical mouse sensor breakout with a TLV74318PDBVR 1.8 V core regulator and an 8-pin JST GH host connector. This connector's pins 1-8 are nRESET, MOTION, SCLK, MOSI, MISO, nCS, VIN, GND. VIN is the external logic supply. A three-pad open solder jumper selects sensor VDDIO between VIN and regulated 1.8 V, with VDDIO on the center pad.
Use the supplied PMW3360 and regulator symbols. Include 10k reset/MISO pull-ups to VDDIO, a 39 ohm LED_P feed, VDDPIX and supply bypassing, and the optional 28k/22 nF regulator pin-4 network for alternate-regulator support. Provide VDDIO, 1.8 V and GND test pads and four grounded plated M2 mounting holes. Use the horizontal 1.25 mm pitch JST GH connector footprint.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (pmw3360_pcb.kicad_sym) and footprint library (pmw3360_pcb.pretty) in lib/ under the project directory; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
